acip: DE YANG JI LTAR GZIGS PA'I NGOR NI GSUM PO MI SNANG LA, JI SNYED PA GZIGS PA'I NGOR NI YUL CAN RANG NYID MA RIG PA'I BAG CHAGS KYIS BSLAD PA'I DBANG GIS SNANG BA MED KYANG, GANG ZAG GZHAN GYI SHES PA BSLAD PA'I DBANG GIS SNANG BA RNAMS, DE LA SNANG BA'I SGO NAS SANGS RGYAS LA SNANG NAS MKHYEN PA YIN NO,,
english: None of the three, moreover, can appear to the perceptions of a person who is seeing the way that all things are. What appears though to the perceptions of a person who is seeing all the things there are? They is no appearance of them to a subject state of mind due to any infection of it by deep seeds for misunderstanding. They can though make their appearance by force of the fact that the awareness of another person's mind is infected; and what is appearing to them then appears to the Buddha, and thus they know them. No strand of hair
